facts.claim: 开篇用网球计分法开玩笑：love 在网球里意为零分，所以“对网球选手来说 love means nothing”
facts.quote: Why should you never date a tennis player? Because to them, love means nothing.

facts.claim: 用“差别是什么”的固定句式收束：in-laws 与 outlaws 的差别被压缩成 outlaws are wanted（被通缉／被需要）
facts.quote: What’s the difference between in-laws and outlaws? Outlaws are wanted.

facts.claim: 一则把“迹象”literal化：与公路养护部门官员约会失败，理由是 all the signs were there（既有“征兆”也有路面标志牌）
facts.quote: I should never have gone out with the officer from the motorway maintenance department. All the signs were there.

facts.claim: 火烈鸟一则把 put my foot down 从“坚决表态”翻回“把脚放下”，靠短语的字面动作收尾
facts.quote: My wife kept asking me to stop impersonating a flamingo. Eventually I had to put my foot down.

facts.claim: 作者用词典释义体开玩笑：弗洛伊德式口误被定义成“说一件事却意指你母亲”，把 Oedipus 情结塞进定义句
facts.quote: A Freudian slip is when you say one thing but mean your mother.

facts.claim: 活梯一则把 stepladder 拆成 step + ladder，造出一个从未谋面的“亲生 ladder”，属构词笑话
facts.quote: I have a stepladder. I never met my real ladder.

facts.claim: 一则自我指涉：妻子抱怨我把她的话都扭成对自己有利，而叙述者把这句抱怨本身也扭成夸奖
facts.quote: My wife says I twist everything she says to my advantage. I take that as a compliment.

facts.claim: 亲子对话体用 no sun 与 no son 同音：儿子问日食是什么，父亲答“没有太阳”，听上去像“没有儿子”
facts.quote: ‘Dad, can you explain to me what a solar eclipse is?’ ‘No sun.’

relations.relation: 同一词在两套语义系统里取值相反：网球记分的 love=0，于是“love 什么都不是”既成立又损人
relations.quote: Because to them, love means nothing.

relations.relation: 公路养护这个职业把隐喻性的“迹象”实体化为路边标志，双关靠职业设定兑现
同音异义：回答日食成因的“没有太阳”与“没有儿子”同音，父亲的话被听成否认亲子关系
把合成词 stepladder 重新切分为 step + ladder，虚构出“亲生 ladder”，属词内切分式双关
relations.quote: I have a stepladder. I never met my real ladder.

numbers.meaning: 外祖母花了五十年才让外祖父戒掉咬指甲，办法是藏起他的假牙，时间跨度用来抬高荒诞落差
numbers.quote: After fifty years, my grandma finally got my grandpa to stop biting his nails.

numbers.meaning: 四岁儿子一则：父亲解释“偶尔拉在裤子里很正常”，结果被儿子嘲笑，年龄设定制造反差
numbers.quote: I explained to my four-year-old son that it’s perfectly normal to sometimes do a poo in your pants.

numbers.meaning: 接孩子放学接错人一则：以为七岁孩子不是亲生，其实是在校门口认错，数字只作日常细节
numbers.quote: I was incredibly upset when I found out my seven-year-old child wasn’t really mine.

numbers.meaning: 朋友吃了五个人，用“难消化”收尾，数量越大越显得轻描淡写
numbers.quote: I’ve just found out a friend of mine has eaten five people. That’s a lot to digest.
